title: Residential Natural Gas Supply — Re-Contract Rate Reduction by Offered Plan Length
content:
On a Residential Natural Gas Supply re-contract after rollover, the commitment reduction depends on the plan named in the final options notice: 0.0150 per therm when it is Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36, 0.0100 per therm when it is Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 or Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24, and no reduction for any other plan. The reduction lowers the re-contract rate by that amount per therm.

The plan read is the plan offered on the most recent final options notice of the expired term.

| Plan named in the final options notice | Commitment reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36 | 0.0150 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24 | 0.0100 |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 | 0.0100 |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 | none |
| Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12 | none |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12 | none |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable | none |

### Illustration (hypothetical notice)

A final options notice offering Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24 carries a commitment reduction of 0.0100 per therm; had it offered Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12, there would be none.
